svg.title: Geologist — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as geologist, wearing a work jacket and a hard hat. Visible work cue: A pointed geological hammer sits above a low angular rock specimen with one visible sediment layer. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a hard hat.
